slides.title: Upachaya
body: Varahamihira's name for these four houses
What sits here starts slow and grows with effort

slides.label: In modern life
slides.title: What each one covers
cells: The side project, the cold email

slides.label: Hard grahas do well here
slides.title: The tough coach
body:
The auditor (Saturn) and the soldier (Mars)
bring pressure
Here, that pressure turns into stamina
Unpleasant at 22, the reason you're good at 35

slides.label: Sutra
slides.quote:
Some parts of your chart
are meant to start rough

slides.label: Practical remedy
slides.title: Give it three years
body: Find which of these houses has a graha in your chart
Pick one habit that feeds it
Judge it after three honest years
slides.closing: Ask about your houses at asksutram.com
